text: Teaching Objectives After graduation, you will be qualified as senior and comprehensive engineering technicians in areas such as production technology and research, engineering construction, industrial enterprise trade, administrative management and training, and so forth. Main courses Chinese Culture and History; Fundamental Law; Introduction to Computing; General Chemistry; Introduction to Aerospace; Probability and Statistics; Linear Algebra; Programming Design Lab; Material Mechanics; Analog Electronic Circuits; Computer-Aided Drafting (AutoCAD); Laboratory of Shenyang Aerospace University; Internship; Metalworking, Mechanical Drawing, Mechanical Design, Electrical Engineering and Electronics Practice, Computer Measurement and Control Technology Comprehensive Practice, Professional Practice, Professional Design, Graduation Design, etc. Degree Awarded Bachelor of Engineering. Future Career After graduation, you can work as comprehensive senior engineers to design mechatronics systems, manufacture products, or develop new technologies in enterprises or research institutes. You can also pursue further research in your major at a university.
